units: returns, distances to highs and volatilities are fractions (0.05 = 5%); session offsets are XNYS session-grid indices
change_policy: any edit changes the canonical checksum and makes this a different study; new values go to d_analog_rules_v2.json with a new declaration

data.plan: Stocks Basic (rolling 2 years, no same-day T bar)
data.source: grouped_daily adjusted=false, include_otc default(false); read from the Strategy C raw cache (data/runtime/strategy_c/raw) read-only
data.reference_snapshots: reference tickers type=CS active=true as of the first XNYS session of each calendar quarter; date D uses the latest snapshot with as_of <= D
data.splits: market-wide /v3/reference/splits records; only execution_date <= t enters F(t)
data.price_basis: P(t) = raw close(t) / F(t), H(t) = raw high(t) / F(t), O(t) = raw open(t) / F(t); F(t) = product of split_from/split_to of the ticker's splits executed <= t

universe.note: same numeric values as the C-M hard filter, declared here independently; D never reads the C rules file
universe.security_type: CS in the snapshot as of D, primary_exchange in allowed_primary_exchanges
universe.adv20_definition: mean(raw close * raw volume) over sessions D-20..D-1
universe.history: a bar on every session D-60..D (61 consecutive session bars)

corporate_action_exclusion.split_window: any split (either direction) with execution_date in (session D-60, D] excludes the ticker-date
corporate_action_exclusion.ca_suspect_window: any P(t)/P(t-1) >= 3.0 or <= 1/3 for t in D-59..D excludes the ticker-date

other_columns_used_only_for.open/high/low: labels (P0, MFE, MAE) and the N2 baseline distance_to_high
other_columns_used_only_for.realized volatility: N1 volatility bucket and N2 baseline

initial_features.d5_rule: only after GATE-D-ALPHA = PASS, as a new declared version

combination_policy: frozen; no window or horizon is added after results; additions are a new version

A.name: z_normalized_close_path
A.vector: z_i = (P(D-W+i) - mean) / std_ddof0 over i = 0..W (length W+1)

B.name: cumulative_log_return_path
B.vector: c_i = ln(P(D-W+i) / P(D-W)) for i = 1..W (length W)

A.equivalence_note: on z vectors with ddof0, ||z_q - z_n||^2 = 2(W+1)(1 - rho); Euclidean on representation A is the same ranking and is NOT a separate test

similarity_methods.tie_break: library end session index ascending, then ticker ascending

dtw.reason: V1 keeps the test family at 14 and the search exact; DTW is allowed only as Top-K reranking in a separately declared version

library.definition: every (ticker, end session d) window that passes the universe rule as of d, has a valid label for the tested horizon h, and satisfies the neighbor policies for the query
library.library_stride_rule: library end session index d with d % 5 == 0 on the session grid
library.min_history: same as universe.history (bars on every session d-60..d)

insufficient_neighbors: fewer than top_k neighbors after all policies -> query excluded as INSUFFICIENT_NEIGHBORS, counted per test

same_symbol_policy.rule: exclude every library window whose ticker equals the query ticker, over the whole history
same_symbol_policy.figi_rule: also exclude a library window whose composite_figi (snapshot as of its end date) equals the query composite_figi (snapshot as of D) when both are non-null
same_symbol_policy.ticker_reuse_handling: a different company that reuses the query ticker is also excluded (conservative); a renamed company without a composite_figi match is not detected (known limitation)

embargo_policy.forward_label_embargo: neighbor label window d+1..d+h must end on or before D (d + h <= D)
embargo_policy.overlapping_window_rule: neighbor span d-W..d+h must end before the query pattern window starts: d + h <= D - W
embargo_policy.effective_rule: d + h <= D - W (strict; implies the forward-label embargo)
embargo_policy.reason: a neighbor whose window or outcome overlaps the query window measures contemporaneous co-movement, not a historical analog

neighbor_concentration_policy.selection: greedy in similarity order, skipping a candidate that would break either cap, until top_k are accepted

labels.available_at: D+1 04:00 ET (signal is known only after D's daily bar is final)
labels.window: sessions D+1..D+h; D itself never included
labels.close_return_h: P(D+h) / P0 - 1, clipped to [-1, 1]; equals the C close_return[h] whenever a bar exists on D+h
labels.excess_return_h: close_return_h minus the median close_return_h over all label-valid eligible tickers of the same date (full universe, not the query sample)
labels.validity: a bar on D+1 (else NO_ENTRY_BAR), a bar on session D+h itself (else MISSING_HORIZON_BAR), not label CA suspect
labels.why_not_c_disappeared: C DISAPPEARED asks whether any bar exists on or after D+h anywhere in the dataset, which reads past D+h; for a neighbor that would read past the query date. The D rule is decidable at D+h, so neighbor validity is known at query time (d + h <= D - W)
labels.ca_window_vs_query: W >= 20 > 10, so the C CA window end d+10 is always <= D - W - h + 10 < D for a usable neighbor

label_ca_suspect.h_le_10: the C LabelSet.label_ca_suspect as is (window D..D+10)
label_ca_suspect.h_20: C window D..D+10 plus the same ratio rule on D+11..D+20 (close(t)/close(t-1) or open(t)/close(t-1) >= 3.0 or <= 1/3)
label_ca_suspect.reason: C labels.LABEL_CA_HORIZON = 10; a synthetic 10x jump at D+15 passes as a valid 20D label today (measured 2026-09-17)

labels.applies_to: query evaluation labels and neighbor labels (same definitions)

similarity_confidence.A: mean rho over the accepted top_k
similarity_confidence.role: descriptive only in V1; never a gate input and never a filter

analog_forward_signal.primary: median of neighbor excess_return_h over the accepted top_k
analog_forward_signal.direction: higher S(q) predicts higher query excess_return_h

baseline_N1.name: random_analog
baseline_N1.purpose: similarity search vs random historical sampling from the same library
baseline_N1.library: the same library the query sees (same universe, label validity, stride, same-symbol and embargo policies)
baseline_N1.matching: library windows in the same realized-volatility quintile as the query; quintile = per-date percentile rank of rv_W over that date's full eligible universe, edges 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8
baseline_N1.draw: top_k windows sampled without replacement in the order of sha256('N1|seed|replicate|query_date|query_ticker|lib_date|lib_ticker'), applying the same concentration caps
baseline_N1.ic: per date, mean of the 20 replicate Spearman ICs
baseline_N1.descriptive_variant_N1b: each accepted real neighbor replaced by a random window of the same library end date and same volatility quintile; reported, never a gate input

baseline_N2.name: simple_price_features

features.realized_vol_W: std_ddof1 of ln(P(t)/P(t-1)) for t in D-W+1..D

baseline_N2.standardization: per-date percentile rank over that date's full eligible universe: (average rank - 1) / (n - 1)
baseline_N2.N2a_feature_knn: same library, policies, top_k, caps and signal as D, with Euclidean distance on the 5 standardized features instead of the path
baseline_N2.N2b_orthogonalized: per date, OLS of rank(S(q)) on the 5 standardized features plus intercept over the valid query sample; Spearman IC of the residual with excess_return_h
baseline_N2.missing: a query with any non-finite N2 feature is excluded from N2a/N2b comparisons only, counted

evaluation.session_grid: all usable sessions of the frozen C raw cache, index 0..N-1 (N is measured in D1)
evaluation.query_dates: every session index in [eval_start_idx, eval_end_idx], common to all 14 tests and all baselines
evaluation.query_sampling: eligible tickers of D ordered by sha256('Q|20260917|D|ticker'), first 300; sampled before label validity is known; invalid labels dropped afterwards and counted
evaluation.ic: Spearman rank correlation between S(q) and excess_return_h over the date's valid queries
evaluation.time_block_rule: evaluable query dates split into 4 consecutive blocks of (near) equal count

statistics.bootstrap: moving block bootstrap over evaluable query dates, block length 20 sessions, 10000 replicates, seed 20260917
statistics.family_wise: Bonferroni over the 14 primary tests: two-sided level 1 - 0.05/14 = 0.99643 for gate conditions; 95% also reported
statistics.paired: differences vs N1 and N2a use per-date paired differences under the same bootstrap draws

primary_metric: mean daily Spearman IC between S(q) (median neighbor excess return) and realized excess_return_h, per (window, horizon, representation)
secondary_metrics: IC of mean neighbor excess return
IC of neighbor hit rate P(excess_return_h > 0)
IC of median neighbor mfe_h and mae_h
query realized mfe_h / mae_h by S(q) quintile
Q5 - Q1 realized excess_return_h spread by S(q) quintile
Spearman correlation of S(q) with each N2 feature
library size, neighbor date/ticker diversity, INSUFFICIENT_NEIGHBORS share
inverse effects (IC CI entirely below 0), reported as INVERSE_EFFECT

per_test_conditions.8_horizon_consistency: every other horizon of the same window and representation has IC point > 0
per_test_conditions.9_sample: evaluable dates >= 150, valid queries >= 20000, unique query tickers >= 1000, INSUFFICIENT_NEIGHBORS share <= 0.05

decision.PASS: at least one of the 14 tests meets all 10 conditions
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: no test passes, and some test meets 1, 2, 3 and 4 but fails only 7, 8 or 9; or the data yields fewer than 150 evaluable dates

pass_fail_policy.negative_direction: a significant negative IC is reported as INVERSE_EFFECT and is never a PASS; using it needs a new declared version
pass_fail_policy.on_FAIL: Strategy D research ends; no backtester, adapter or trading spec
pass_fail_policy.on_INCONCLUSIVE: no D5; the only allowed follow-up is a data-depth decision recorded as a new version
pass_fail_policy.on_PASS: D5 ablation (OHLC / volume / volatility) and D6 long historical OOS, then GATE-D-OOS; nothing proceeds automatically
pass_fail_policy.pass_meaning: the analog signal carries information beyond random analogs and simple price features in this data window; it is not evidence of a profitable strategy

checksum_recipe: sha256 of json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded UTF-8, i.e. app.backtest.strategy_c_selection.rules.canonical_checksum; recorded in d_analog_rules_v1.sha256
